question: Music composer Debojyoti Mishra has won the Best Music Director award at the 20th Imagine India Film Festival in __________ for his work in film ‘Bansuri: The Flute’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 20th Imagine India Film Festival was held in Spain, recognizing outstanding contributions to cinema.
 
• Debojyoti Mishra won the Best Music Director award for his work in the film 'Bansuri: The Flute'.
 
• 'Bansuri: The Flute' is a renowned film that has received critical acclaim for its music and storytelling.
 
• The Imagine India Film Festival is known for celebrating artistic excellence and cultural diversity in the film industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Imagine India Film Festival**

 
 
• The Imagine India Film Festival is an annual event that takes place in Spain, focusing on showcasing films from India and other Asian countries.
 
• The festival aims to promote cultural exchange and understanding through cinema, providing a platform for filmmakers to showcase their work.
 
• It features a variety of categories, including feature films, documentaries, and short films, with awards given for different aspects of filmmaking such as direction, acting, and music.
 
• The festival attracts international attention and participation, highlighting the diverse and rich cinematic traditions of the participating countries.
 
 
 
• **Debojyoti Mishra**
 
 
• Debojyoti Mishra is an acclaimed Indian music composer known for his work in both the film industry and theatre.
 
• He has composed music for numerous films, receiving accolades for his ability to blend traditional and contemporary music styles.
 
• His work in 'Bansuri: The Flute' has been particularly praised for its emotional depth and musical sophistication.
 
• Mishra has also been involved in various cultural projects and collaborations, contributing to the enrichment of Indian music and arts.
 
 
 
• **'Bansuri: The Flute'**
 
 
• 'Bansuri: The Flute' is a film that tells a poignant story, enriched by its musical score composed by Debojyoti Mishra.
 
• The film has garnered attention for its narrative and the way music is intricately woven into the storytelling.
 
• It has been featured in several film festivals, receiving praise for its artistic and technical achievements.
 
• The music of the film plays a crucial role in conveying the emotional undertones and enhancing the overall viewing experience.
